9-panel cinematic storyboard CONTACT SHEET derived from Image 1. Mix Wide, Medium, and Tight shots of the same scene.

Layout: a rigid 3x3 grid of 9 equal rectangular cells in a 16:9 landscape image. Each cell is exactly 1/3 of the width and 1/3 of the height. Separate cells with a thin black gutter.
- Content must not cross, bleed, or overlap a gutter. No collage.
- Each cell is a complete, independently framed shot — not a crop of a larger scene.

Scene: wide, eye level, Scarlett (Image 2) steps into the crowded crosswalk in a black-and-neutral outfit, carrying her tote with relaxed posture and coral lips as the bright focal point., Scarlett (Image 2) crosses through the center of a broad 16:9 street frame, surrounded by commuters, taxis, delivery bikes, and mirrored towers., downtown_crosswalk, Bright late-morning daylight reflects off mirrored towers, car windows, and taxi surfaces. Sunlight flashes across moving vehicles while the pedestrian space remains evenly lit., Neutral black, gray, cream, glass blue, asphalt charcoal, taxi yellow, muted canvas, and Scarlett (Image 2)'s vivid coral lipstick as the primary saturated fashion color., Scarlett (Image 2), Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save

Every panel is a shot of the same scene as Image 1 — keep the characters, wardrobe, lighting, color grade, and texture consistent across all panels.

No text, dialogue bubbles, scene numbers, or watermarks.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
Image 1 (primary): Primary source scene — generate 9 variant shots from this image
Image 3 (location): Downtown Crosswalk - A busy downtown intersection framed by a broad pedestrian crosswalk
